### Page note: https://www.countyhealthrankings.org/health-data/idaho/data-and-resources
Reader state: complete; relevance: partial
**Page:** Data and Resources – Idaho  
**URL:** https://www.countyhealthrankings.org/health-data/idaho/data-and-resources  

**Evidence**  
* “**2023 Idaho Data**” – link to `https://www.countyhealthrankings.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2023%20County%20Health%20Rankings%20Idaho%20Data%20-%20v2.xlsx` (282.84 KB, SHEET)  
* “**2023 Idaho Health Outcomes Map**” – link to `https://www.countyhealthrankings.org/sites/default/files/media/image/2023_idaho_health_outcome_map.png` (178.47 KB, PNG)  
* “**2023 Idaho Health Factors Map**” – link to `https://www.countyhealthrankings.org/sites/default/files/media/image/2023_idaho_health_factor_map.png` (174.48 KB, PNG)  
* List of data files for years 2025‑2020, 2019‑2010 (various XLSX, XLS, PDF, PNG).  
* “**Idaho COVID‑19 Resources**” section with two sub‑links.  
* “**Idaho Data Sources**” table listing source names, descriptions, and whether they allow demographic or sub‑county breakdown.  
* Footers and navigation menus providing links to other sections of the site.  

**Coverage**  
The page lists data resources for the state of Idaho for years 2010 through 2025. The listed resources are a complete catalogue of the files provided on this page for each year. No table rows or measurement values are actually present on the page itself; all substantive data lie behind the linked documents.  

**Missing**  
* No county‑level data values for adult obesity rate or overall uninsured rate.  
* No per‑county list of entities, measures, or dates presented directly on this page.  

**Next links**  
* `https://www.countyhealthrankings.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2023%20County%20Health%20Rankings%20Idaho%20Data%20-%20v2.xlsx` – the 2023 XLSX file likely contains the county‑by‑county measures needed (obesity rate, uninsured rate, etc.).  
* `https://www.countyhealthrankings.org/sites/default/files/media/image/2023_idaho_health_outcome_map.png` – the 2023 Health Outcomes Map may visually encode obesity and uninsured rates.  
* `https://www.countyhealthrankings.org/sites/default/files/media/image/2023_idaho_health_factor_map.png` – the 2023 Health Factors Map may also contain relevant rates.
